name: review-agents
title: Review & build agents (rubber-duk-*)
summary: Adversarial subagents in .claude/agents: code reviewer, security auditor, backend and frontend builders, unit-test and e2e specialists — stack-neutral bodies plus a per-repo stack profile and starter convention docs (comment policy, test quality, test layout, e2e conventions).

plugins.why: Every agent grounds its findings with the research-planning:iterative-research skill.
rubber-duk-frontend loads frontend-design:frontend-design as its aesthetic spine.
rubber-duk-e2e heals failing specs with superpowers:systematic-debugging.

vendorSkills.why: rubber-duk-frontend checks UI against the Web Interface Guidelines.
The stack profile tells reviewers to load the React best-practice skills.
The Next.js stack profile's framework skills.
rubber-duk-tests loads the vitest skill for runner semantics.
Browser verification when the Playwright MCP server isn't configured.

choices.label: rubber-duk-review
choices.description: Hostile read-only code reviewer (conventions, anti-patterns, comments, eager-fail, test gaps).

choices.label: rubber-duk-auditor
choices.description: Read-only security auditor (CSP, secrets, trust boundaries, cookies, supply chain).

choices.label: rubber-duk-backend
choices.description: Builds and reviews server-side / non-UI changes.

choices.label: rubber-duk-frontend
choices.description: Builds and reviews UI against the Web Interface Guidelines + frontend-design.

choices.label: rubber-duk-e2e
choices.description: Writes, heals and audits e2e specs (E1–E7).

choices.label: Next.js / React
choices.description: Next.js App Router, Cache Components, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind 4 hunt lists and skills.
